## Headcount and Attrition Report 2025

People Analytics

## 1. Summary

Salaried headcount at 31 December 2025 was 650. Group voluntary attrition was 9.8%, above the 7% target. Engineering and Sales had the highest regretted attrition.

## 2. By department

Salaried staff only; hourly production staff are reported in the Operations report.

| Department | Salaried headcount | Hires 2025 | Leavers 2025 | Attrition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Engineering | 111 | 21 | 11 | 9.9% |
| Executive Office | 10 | 2 | 1 | 10.0% |
| Finance | 42 | 8 | 4 | 9.5% |
| Human Resources | 37 | 3 | 5 | 13.5% |
| IT | 39 | 6 | 3 | 7.7% |
| Legal & Compliance | 24 | 3 | 2 | 8.3% |
| Marketing | 38 | 4 | 3 | 7.9% |
| Operations | 204 | 15 | 23 | 11.3% |
| Procurement | 36 | 4 | 5 | 13.9% |
| Quality | 49 | 6 | 1 | 2.0% |
| Sales | 60 | 5 | 5 | 8.3% |
